KAGEKUNI.Settings.ProxyUrl.Name: Proxy Server URL
KAGEKUNI.Settings.ProxyUrl.Hint: The URL of your local proxy server (e.g. http://localhost:3100)
KAGEKUNI.Settings.ActorName.Name: Assistant Actor Name
KAGEKUNI.Settings.ActorName.Hint: Name of the actor that speaks assistant responses in chat. Created automatically if it doesn't exist.
KAGEKUNI.Settings.JournalFolder.Name: Context Journal Folder
KAGEKUNI.Settings.JournalFolder.Hint: Only journal entries in this folder (and subfolders) will be sent as lore context. Leave blank to use all journals.
KAGEKUNI.Settings.MaxContextEntries.Name: Max Journal Entries
KAGEKUNI.Settings.MaxContextEntries.Hint: Maximum number of journal entries to include as context per request (to manage token usage).
KAGEKUNI.Chat.Error: The spirits fall silent. (Connection error — is your proxy running?)
